channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Pesquisa BTG/Nexus hoje: veja números do segundo turno para Lula x Flávio
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll for 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 50.5% and Lula at 49.5% in the second-round vote, within a 2.2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio tem 50,5% dos votos válidos e Lula soma 49,5%, mostra pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll released the day before the presidential runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 50.5% of valid votes and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 49.5%, keeping the candidates in a technical tie. Although the senator holds a slight numerical edge, the margin of error suggests the final result could be even closer.

item.title: Pesquisa BTG/Nexus segundo turno: veja números de Lula x Flávio atualizados
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll released on 10/24/2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in the presidential runoff, with 50.5% of valid votes against 49.5%. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points, and the difference from the previous survey (10/19) is minimal.

item.title: Quantos votos Lula teve no primeiro turno? Veja resultado das Eleições 2026
item.description: Lula received 53,879,538 votes in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, securing a spot in the second round against Flávio Bolsonaro. The results were confirmed by the TSE with a 21.07% abstention rate, the highest ever recorded. The second round is scheduled for October 25th.

item.title: Pesquisa de votos para presidente: veja números de Lula x Flávio na BTG/Nexus hoje
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released today projects a tight race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential runoff, within the margin of error of 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas: Cadu de Lula tem 51,1% e Allyson, 48,9% dos votos válidos no RN
item.description: Atlas/PollsterGraph poll shows a technical tie between Cadu de Lula (PT) and Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil) for RN governor, with 51.1% and 48.9% of valid votes, respectively. A two-point margin of error makes the race statistically balanced.

item.title: Milei chama Lula de “ladrão e mentiroso” ao comentar fala sobre Argentina
item.description: Argentina's President Javier Milei called Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a 'thief and liar' after the PT candidate claimed Argentines were eating donkey meat due to poverty. The statement followed Lula's criticism of Milei's economic model during a debate, linking it to Flávio Bolsonaro's proposals.

item.title: Atlas: Cadu (PT) tem 51,1% e Allysson (União) marca 48,9% ao governo do RN
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows Cadu (PT) leading with 51.1% vs 48.9% for Allysson (União) in RN. Lula also leads presidential race with 63% vs Flávio Bolsonaro (37%). Survey of 1,780 voters with 2 point margin of error.

item.title: Ex de Janones após ir a debate: “Não é sobre vingança, nunca foi”
item.description: Leandra Guedes, mayor of Ituiutaba and former partner of André Janones, denied that her presence at the TV Globo debate was motivated by revenge, stating she speaks for women who suffer violence. Their relationship was marked by a protective measure granted in 2024 following allegations of threats and leaked intimate images, which Janones denies. While Leandra attended the debate at Flávio Bolsonaro’s invitation, Janones, who supports Lula, did not participate and held a 24-hour live stream in support of the president.

item.title: Flávio e Lula fecham campanha levando multidões para atos no RJ e em SP
item.description: Lula closed his campaign with a walk on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, while Flávio Bolsonaro ended his campaign with a rally in Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro. Both candidates mobilized crowds in simultaneous events on the eve of the runoff election. The campaign's final stretch was marked by efforts to win voters ahead of Sunday's vote.

item.title: Sistemas do TSE estão blindados contra fraudes, diz Kassio Nunes Marques
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques stated that the electoral systems are ready and protected against fraud during the Electoral Systems Verification Ceremony. The audit confirmed no changes were made to the software, ensuring vote integrity. The process is part of security protocols for the 2026 election.

item.title: Pesquisa eleitoral BTG/Nexus aponta Flávio Bolsonaro à frente no segundo turno das eleições 2026
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows a tight race between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) in a potential 2026 runoff, with Bolsonaro holding a slight edge in likely voter models. Lula faces higher rejection rates, though the gap remains within the 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Vicentinho tem 59,5% dos votos válidos contra 40,5% de Dorinha no TO
item.description: A AtlasIntel survey released on October 24, 2026 shows federal deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading with 59.5% of valid voting intentions against 40.5% for Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) in the second round of the Tocantins gubernatorial race. When including blank and null votes, Vicentinho holds 53.6% and Dorinha, 36.5%, while 6.3% opted for blank or null votes. The study surveyed 1,891 voters between October 18 and 23 and is registered with the TSE under number TO-01088/2026.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Celina lidera para governo do DF com 59% dos votos válidos e Grass tem 41%, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on October 24, 2026, shows that the Federal District governor, Celina Leão (PP), leads the reelection race with 59% of valid votes, against 41% for PT candidate Leandro Grass. The survey, commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo and TV Globo, interviewed 1620 people on October 23-24, with a ±2 point margin of error.

item.title: Quaest: Celina Leão lidera com 61% dos votos válidos; Leandro Grass tem 39%
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 24 shows incumbent Federal District Governor Celina Leão (PP) leading with 61% of valid votes in the GDF race, against 39% for Leandro Grass (PT). Across all voters, Leão holds 50% of voting intentions, while Grass has 35%, with 9% indicating blank or null votes and 6% undecided. The survey has a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level, and was registered with the TSE.

item.title: Celina tem 57,9% dos votos válidos e Grass, 42,1%, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: A AtlasIntel survey released on October 24, 2026 shows Celina Leão (PP) leading with 57.9% of valid votes against Leandro Grass (PT) at 42.1% in the DF runoff. The poll surveyed 1,807 voters from October 18-23, with a ±2 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level. The study is registered with the TSE and cost BRL 75,000.

item.title: Dívida bruta de 82,9% do PIB pressiona futuro governo, diz investidor
item.description: The government's gross debt reaches 82.9% of GDP, pressuring the next president. Corino Capital investor sees a sharper repricing in case of Lula's reelection and projects fiscal challenges for both candidates. The analysis was released one day before the 2026 runoff.

item.title: Debate da Globo: caso da menina Ana Clara e discussão sobre os ‘nove dedos’ concentraram repercussão nas redes
item.description: The Globo presidential debate was dominated by reactions to the Ana Clara case and Flávio Bolsonaro's 'nine fingers' comment, according to analysis institutes. Instituto Democracia em Xeque sees Lula's advantage online, while Bites reports a technical tie and narrative asymmetry.

item.title: Datafolha para presidente no DF, votos válidos: Flávio Bolsonaro, 56%; Lula, 44%
item.description: Datafolha poll released the day before the 2026 DF runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 56% of valid votes against Lula (PT) at 44%. The survey interviewed 1,620 voters on October 23-24, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Gerp sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula, a última antes do segundo turno
item.description: The latest Gerp poll, released Saturday October 24th, shows Flávio Bolsonaro at 52% of valid votes and Lula at 48%, indicating a technical tie. The 4-point difference falls below the institute's statistical significance threshold. Regionally, Flávio leads in the Center-West, South, and North, while Lula remains strong in the Northeast.

item.title: Flávio tem 52% dos votos válidos contra 48% de Lula, diz Gerp
item.description: A Gerp poll for Brazil's 2026 presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (52%) and Lula (48%). With a 2-point margin of error, the candidates remain statistically even, with Flávio leading only in valid votes. The second round will take place on Sunday (Oct 25, 2026).

item.title: Ao TSE, PGE se manifesta contra suspensão do canal "Exército do Lula"
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office (PGE) opposed the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, arguing that coordinated supporter mobilization and reproduction of political content do not constitute electoral fraud. The opinion was sent to the TSE after a ruling by Minister Floriano Marques maintaining the channel's operation. According to PGE, evidence of fake accounts, bots, or irregular engagement purchases is required to prove misconduct.

item.title: Flávio encerra campanha na frente da casa do pai no Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro concluded his campaign in Rio de Janeiro in front of his father Jair Bolsonaro's house, emphasizing support for the former president and pledging to restore purchasing power and defend freedom. The campaign used the slogan 'O Brasil Vai Vencer' and mobilized supporters ahead of the second round against Lula.

item.title: Candidato a vice de Flávio Bolsonaro aciona Justiça contra Tabata Amaral
item.description: Vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar filed a criminal complaint against deputy Tabata Amaral over unverified rape allegations. The legal action follows a video statement by Tabata, which Gaspar labels as defamation and demands clarification. The case is linked to prior investigations at the Supreme Court and other judicial proceedings involving political opponents.

item.title: Nexus/BTG mostra Flávio Bolsonaro com 50,5% e Lula com 49,5% na véspera do 2º turno
item.description: Nexus/BTG poll released on October 24, 2026 shows technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 50.5% and Lula (PT) with 49.5% on the eve of the second round. Among likely voters, Bolsonaro leads with 52.4% against Lula's 47.6%. The survey interviewed 2,000 people between October 23 and 24, with a margin of error of ±2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Pesquisa Atlas: Pazolini tem 51,2% dos votos válidos ao governo do ES; Ferraço marca 47,4%
item.description: Atlas/PollsterGraph survey shows Lorenzo Pazolini (Republicanos) leading Ricardo Ferraço (MDB) with 51.2% of valid votes for Espírito Santo governor, against 48.8%. In the presidential race, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 58.5% of voting intentions, surpassing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) with 41.5%.

item.title: Lula assume compromisso contra o trabalho escravo; Flávio fica de fora
item.description: Lula (PT) signed the Commitment Letter against Slave Labor, prioritizing the fight against this crime and human trafficking in his mandate. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) was invited, but did not respond to the appeal.

item.title: 183 cartunistas fazem pôster conjunto em apoio a Lula
item.description: 183 cartoonists created a joint artwork supporting Lula, the re-election candidate, featuring campaign elements like the 'L' hand gesture and the number 13. The initiative underscores strong artistic backing for Lula as he faces Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Leandra, ex de Janones, fala após debate da Globo: "Não é sobre vingança
item.description: Leandra Guedes, mayor of Ituiutaha and ex-wife of André Janones, participated in the Globo presidential debate invited by Flávio Bolsonaro, stating her presence was not motivated by revenge but by defending silenced women. Janones, an ally of Lula, could not attend the event due to a protective measure granted to Leandra in 2025 following allegations of threats to release intimate content.

item.title: ‘Não me interessa o que pensa Trump’, diz Celso Amorim a VEJA
item.description: Celso Amorim told VEJA he does not care about Trump's opinion on the Brazilian elections, focusing on domestic support for Lula's government while warning about the influence of Big Techs on politics. He emphasized the importance of national interests prevailing over foreign pressures, particularly digital algorithms that allegedly favored Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Sistema eleitoral está blindado contra ingerência indevida, diz Kassio
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that the Brazilian electoral system is protected against any undue interference following an audit of the voting machine integrity. The verification confirmed the authenticity of the systems used in the second round of the 2026 elections and the issuance of the zeroth record. The minister emphasized the importance of transparency and the preservation of the electronic vote.

item.title: 6 pesquisas mostram disputa apertada entre Flávio e Lula neste sábado
item.description: Six polls released this week show an extremely tight race between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the second round of the 2026 presidential elections. In five of the polls, Flávio is ahead, though within the margin of error, suggesting a technical tie. Only one poll, by Vox Brasil, shows Lula leading. The second round will take place this Sunday, October 25, 2026.

item.title: Hailey Bieber manifesta apoio a Lula
item.description: Hailey Bieber, an American influencer of Brazilian mother, expressed support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a post on her Instagram, resharing content by photographer Rafael Pavarotti highlighting democratic values, indigenous rights, the Amazon, education, science, and culture. The post was published the day before the 2026 presidential runoff, in which Lula runs for reelection against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE deve regular meios de comunicação para evitar “ringue”, diz Toffoli
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli advocated for regulating communication media to prevent electoral campaigns from turning into a 'brawl', criticizing the use of public time for candidate offenses. He emphasized the need to return to discussing public policies instead of personal confrontations.

item.title: Flávio gasta 6 vezes o valor de Lula em anúncios na última semana de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) spent R$6.79 million on Meta ads in the final week of campaigning, 6.2 times more than Lula (PT), who invested R$1.09 million. Flávio's ads focused on public security and Tarcísio de Freitas' image, accounting for 49.3% of total spending on the page. BBC News Brasil collected the data from Meta's Ad Library, which differs from TSE information.

item.title: Queda de guindaste na Linha 15 prejudica ida de apoiadores a ato pró-Lula
item.description: An accident between a Linha 15-Prata train and a crane on Avenida Professor Luiz Ignácio de Anhaia Mello disrupted the movement of protesters heading to a pro-Lula rally on Avenida Paulista in São Paulo. With buses unavailable and ride-hailing prices high, some supporters chose to walk to the event.

item.title: Saiba os direitos de idosos e pessoas com deficiência para votar
item.description: Brazilian legislation ensures accessibility rights and priority service for elderly citizens and people with disabilities or reduced mobility during elections. These measures include adapted infrastructure, accessibility coordinators, reserved parking spaces, and section transfers to better accommodate voters.

item.title: A boa notícia das pesquisas internas de Lula na véspera da eleição
item.description: Internal qualitative surveys from Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 2026 campaign suggest a favorable outlook for the PT candidate in the final stretch, boosting morale among supporters. The data, not yet made public, was published exclusively for subscribers of a specific news outlet. This development has served as an emotional boost for the Petitioner base before the vote.

item.title: Lula e Flávio concordam em mínimo acima da inflação e em mais 6 temas
item.description: Lula and Flávio agreed on seven economic issues during the TV Globo debate, including Bolsa Família, railways, small businesses, debt renegotiation, minimum wage, weekend free fares, and veto on privatizations. Flávio preserved social programs and strategic state companies, while Lula pushed for expanded weekend public transport fare exemptions.

item.title: Presidente do TSE defende urnas a observadores internacionais: "Super Bowl"
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques defended the security and transparency of Brazil's electronic voting system by comparing the electoral operation to the Super Bowl, during a meeting with international observers covering the presidential runoff.

item.title: Mãe de Ana Clara participa de ato de Lula em Copacabana após embate com Flávio Bolsonaro em debate
item.description: The mother of Ana Clara, a girl killed by police gunfire in Niterói, attended Lula's rally in Copacabana after clashing with Flávio Bolsonaro in the Globo debate. Lula used the case to question Flávio's defense of the accused officer at the STJ. Her presence was orchestrated by the PT campaign to emphasize security and justice in the final stretch.

item.title: Toffoli defende que TSE edite regras para que propagandas e debates não sejam 'ringues' e 'voltem' a discutir política
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli advocated for the TSE to establish rules preventing political advertisements and debates from becoming 'duels', emphasizing policy proposals over personal attacks between candidates.

item.title: “Quem ganha em Minas ganha no Brasil”, diz Flávio ao lado de Cleitinho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that winning Minas Gerais and São Paulo signals presidential victory. He participated in a motorcycle rally in Belo Horizonte alongside Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), the newly elected governor of Minas.

item.title: PGR pede ao STF para suspender decisão de Nunes Marques que restringe transporte de indígenas no segundo turno
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested the Supreme Court to suspend a decision by the TSE president, Nunes Marques, requiring prior authorization for transporting Indigenous voters in the second round. The PGR argues this rule may prevent 7,200 Indigenous voters, many dependent on river transport, from voting, and asks to reinstate a previously approved federal plan. Nunes Marques' order requires detailed identification of vehicles, routes, and schedules.

item.title: PGR pede que STF derrube exigência de autorização prévia para transporte de indígenas no 2º turno
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet requested the Supreme Federal Court to overturn the requirement for prior authorization to transport indigenous people during the second round of the 2026 elections. The TSE determination mandated authorization for indigenous transportation during the electoral process.

item.title: Lula discursa no Rio e Flávio evita falar em BH: entenda o que a lei permite na véspera da eleição
item.description: On the eve of the runoff, Lula gave speeches during a walk in Copacabana, while Flávio Bolsonaro avoided a formal address in the BH motorcycle rally to prevent it from being classified as a prohibited rally. The distinction lies in the event format, not a ban on vote requests.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula realiza ato na av. Paulista
item.description: President Lula concludes his campaign with a walk on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo at 4 PM, following a morning rally in Copacabana, Rio. The event features allies such as Geraldo Alckmin, Fernando Haddad, Marina Silva, and Simone Tebet, amid heightened political activity before Sunday's vote.

item.title: Matteo Bocelli entrega suas preferências no Brasil
item.description: Matteo Bocelli, son of Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, acknowledges that part of the audience watches him due to his surname and not just his talent, in statements to VEJA magazine. At 29 years old, he is seeking to build his own artistic identity and is preparing for a tour through Brazil, visiting eight cities with his band, with a show in São Paulo on Saturday, October 24, 2026.

item.title: Ana Clara e erro de Lula lideram menções sobre debate, diz Bites
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro generated 1.5 million mentions on social media, with emphasis on the death of Ana Clara (257k) and Lula's misstatement about 'ending the police' (194k). Flávio leads in positive sentiment, but Lula has higher digital engagement.

item.title: Com volume recorde de processos, TSE terá de julgar ações que vão desde acusação de favorecimento de plataformas a 'rede de desinformação'
item.description: The 2026 elections set a record with 1,476 legal cases at the TSE, including allegations of disinformation and platform bias. Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 624 cases, followed by Lula with 473. The court prioritizes urgent matters during the vote but may rule on ineligibility cases afterward.
